writer_gaps.note: Series says five 8-month male baseline; samples say 9-month young; paper says eleven 9-month female baseline.
Age levels combine mouse 9/13 months with rat embryo; only mice support aging comparison.
Treatment and age are not fully crossed; young mice are control only and in vitro is separate.
Only 5-6 mice/group were sequenced from larger 22-23/group behavior cohorts.
Rat primary neurons were prepared from multiple day-17 embryos, not individually identified.
Sex and rat strain are not stated for primary neuron samples; genotype not stated.
Mouse doses are ppm in diet; neuron dose is µM in culture, not directly comparable.
Control groups are biological baseline/vehicle, not input or IgG background libraries.
Generic treatment protocol mentions CAD031, CMS 121 and J147, but only CMS121/J147 samples exist.
